_tuning_notes: Jungle python: no venom — special.constrict gives a brief grab on strike (constrict_ticks, reusing the crocodile GrabHold path: drag + heavy slowness, no chewing). Same warning etiquette as the viper. Phase 3: diet.hunts doubles as cage-trap bait (item form of the prey). Deliberately NOT breedable: worldgen ambience animal — its population is meant to be found, not farmed, and a breedable one would trivially defeat the worldgen_only scarcity. RARITY: tier 'uncommon' supplies the spawn weight; group_size and nearby_cap are pinned here (1-1, cap 3). nearby_cap denies natural spawns when that many of this animal are already within 64 blocks — the fix for persistent CREATURE mobs accumulating forever.
